title: Ruleset manifest (ruleset.json)
description: The top-level manifest of a rulesets/<id>/ directory: identity, format version, the ruleset's own version, every property the ruleset's actors carry, each named in the table's words, and, optionally, how a character's sheet is laid out, the name for an ability that spends no resource and the forms a catalogue entry takes. See internal/rules/load.go for the authoritative loader; this document is the external contract for ruleset authors and is cross-checked against loader behavior by internal/rules/schema_test.go.

id.description: The ruleset's id. Must not be empty. At most 128 bytes of UTF-8.

name.description: The ruleset's display name. Must not be empty. At most 256 bytes of UTF-8.

format_version.description: Only "3" is accepted by this loader. Any other value, a retired format's among them, is refused with what format "3" declares (docs/adr/012-the-rules-contract.md). See atom.schema.json for the atoms/*.json this format composes abilities from.

version.description: The ruleset's own version: free text its author declares and keeps true, not the format's, which is format_version. Must not be empty. At most 128 bytes of UTF-8.

properties.description: Every property the ruleset's actors carry, in the order the ruleset declares them. A key is declared once, whatever its type.

key.description: What an expression reads: '@'+key for a number, '#'+key for a resource. Must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$, the expression grammar's IDENT charset (internal/rules/expr.go), not kebab-case, since a hyphenated key would lex as subtraction ("brawn-2" -> "brawn" - 2); must not be "caster" or "target". At most 128 bytes of UTF-8.

type.description: A number is one value on an actor's sheet; a resource is a current value under a maximum.

name.description: The property's display name: what the table calls it, shown wherever the window names it.

description.description: What the property means at the table, for a player and for the agent.

default_max_expr.description: A resource only. Optional expression (see internal/rules/expr.go grammar). Dice (NdM) are rejected at load time in v1: this expression is evaluated without recording its rolls, so a die here would draw from the Roller unrecorded.

when.description: Expression; non-zero result means the threshold is met. Dice (NdM) are rejected at load time in v1: a threshold 'when' is evaluated without recording its rolls, which would break the rolled-once-recorded-forever testimony contract (spec §2 decision 3).

apply_condition.description: A condition id declared under conditions/.

thresholds.description: A resource only: conditions that follow its value.

free_usage_name.description: Optional. What the table calls an ability that spends no resource. When present, it must not be empty.

forms.description: Optional. The forms a catalogue entry takes, in the order the ruleset declares them, each with the number properties an entry of that form carries. A ruleset may declare none. A key is declared by one form.

key.description: The form's key; no two forms share one. At most 128 bytes of UTF-8.

name.description: The form's display name: what the table calls an entry of it.

description.description: What an entry of the form is at the table, for a player and for the agent.

properties.description: Optional. Keys of declared number properties, each listed once: the properties an entry of this form carries. A form may list none.

sheet.description: Optional. How a character's sheet is laid out: its pages, in order, each of named sections, each showing one of the character's values, its conditions or its abilities. A ruleset may declare none. A property key stands at most once among the sections' values, a usage at most once among their abilities, and the conditions in at most one section; a property need not stand at all, and a key may stand both as a value and in the usage that spends it. When a sheet is declared, every ability's usage stands in a section.

name.description: The page's name; no two pages share one.

values.description: Keys of declared properties, shown in this order.

conditions.description: The section shows the character's conditions.

spends.description: The key of a declared resource property: the section shows the abilities that spend it.

abilities.description: The usages whose abilities the section shows: "at_will", or an object naming the resource the abilities spend.
